what_this_is: Products whose price Atlas holds and keeps, but which PlotNua must not use for price-based matching, budget fit or price comparison, and which may be shown only with the qualification below immediately beside the figure. Read by .github/scripts/generate_garden_room_universe.py, which sets priceSafeForMatching false and carries priceEvidence.presentationHold for each listed product. Because search (build-search-index.py G7) publishes a price only where priceSafeForMatching is true, search carries no figure for these products. your-plot.html pnPriceView() shows the qualification in place of the figure (the product page and its cards cannot show the qualification beside every figure, so the figure is suppressed there). atlas-tools/build-maker-explorer.py shows the figure with the qualification in the same line. atlas-tools/prove-explorer-price-parity.mjs proves both. An unreadable register refuses the run.
decision: Founder decision, 6 Nov 2026 15:04, 'PLOTNUA — STAGE 3A NOOK PREFAB CONTROLLED PUBLICATION' items 2 and 3: conservative option; NOOK excluded from price-based matching and budget-fit calculations on Your Plot; wherever a price is displayed, an immediately visible qualification; if a component cannot safely display it, suppress the price on that component. The qualification wording is the founder's.
liftWhen: The website can clearly distinguish an ex works starting price, VAT excluded, transport, foundations and installation additional, and Irish delivery terms unconfirmed, AND the founder approves lifting the hold for the product.

holds.product: Rayco Modular Homes Garden Room (entry range)
holds.basis: EUR 29,500 'Starting From', Partially Verified (27 Aug 2026). Atlas records it as Rayco's site-wide headline across modular homes, garden rooms and extensions, not a garden-room price. On 6 Nov 2026 raycomodularhomes.ie/homes/garden-rooms shows no price, and its FAQ says foundation, external connections and permits are quoted separately.
holds.qualification: Rayco does not publish a current garden-room price. Its earlier starting price covered its whole modular range, so ask Rayco for a garden-room quote. Foundation, external connections and permits are quoted separately.
holds.label: Price on request
holds.reason: Rayco does not publish a current garden-room price, so PlotNua does not compare this room with your budget or other prices.
holds.liftWhen: Rayco publishes, or confirms in writing, a current garden-room-specific price with its VAT basis, recorded in Atlas and approved by the founder.

decision_stage3b: Founder decision, 6 Nov 2026 19:10, 'PLOTNUA — STAGE 3B EAST COAST CARPENTRY ATLAS IMPLEMENTATION AND PUBLICATION PREPARATION', Part 2: extend the NOOK hold narrowly; product-specific qualification wording; until geographical matching exists, East Coast Carpentry is excluded from price-based matching, budget fit and price-filtered search, and its prices are never presented as nationwide offers. Optional fields: 'label' (Your Plot's price slot, in place of the figure), 'reason' (Your Plot's reason line), 'vatBasis' ('included' lets the Maker Explorer show a VAT-inclusive held price as the figure followed by the qualification). Absent on the NOOK holds, so NOOK is unchanged. Founder decision D1(b), 6 Nov 2026 20:09: 'region' makes the restriction explicit wherever availability is shown — Your Plot reads 'Available in Dublin and Wicklow only' in place of the generic 'Irish availability', and the Maker Explorer's maker header, product status and A-Z line read the same. Display only: no matching or ranking change.
decision_stage3c: Founder decision, Stage 3C, 6 Nov 2026 21:37: approve a Rayco price-presentation hold. The product stays discoverable; EUR 29,500 is excluded from price matching, budget fit and price-filtered search, is never shown as a verified garden-room price or as an installed-price offer, and the homeowner is told a current garden-room price needs confirmation from Rayco. 'figure': 'withheld' means no surface shows the figure at all (the NOOK and ECC holds show it beside their qualification). No price is substituted.
